scope: Chrome: real App with local controlled multiplayer players; separate real expedition button flow. No remote multiplayer room was created.

checks: No opponent card reveal before SHOWDOWN
Prepare / raise / release / recover precede card comparison
HP/energy and impact feedback wait for production settlement
Emoji/language re-render does not remount action or card flight
Ultimate cutins use the same round key and original deadline
Only the local player receives a perspective canvas after a confirmed move reaches SHOWDOWN
Opponents keep their ordinary four poses without any perspective canvas
Single warped image replaces original, never two visible hands
Head/feet and pixels outside raised ellipse remain unchanged
Release uses smaller region; pixels outside it remain unchanged
Sprite foot anchor and full-body dimensions remain fixed
localHandPerspective.pixelTolerance: GPU canvas readback may differ by <=1 RGB with identical alpha; all larger changes must remain within hand ellipse.

checks: App and OS: reduced at start, then disabled
App and OS: normal start, enabled at 200 ms, disabled at 300 ms
No late cutin, re-flown card, or reappearing pose in the same round

realExpedition.mode: Real beginner expedition buttons, real committed AI and production settlement; no synthetic combat state, no fake clock.

limitations: Desktop Chrome viewport emulation, not physical iPad/Safari hardware.
Controlled multiplayer rendering does not substitute for live network latency testing.
Previews sample the real UI using synchronized JS/CSS timelines; they are not live multiplayer recordings.
